t: This is Annesley Lodge, a gatehouse in the London Borough of Camden. It was designed by Charles Voysey, who lived from 1857 to 1941. Voysey was an English architect and also designed furniture and textiles. He began with wallpapers, fabrics and furnishings in an Arts and Crafts style, and made an important contribution to the Modern Style. He's best known for several country houses, so a London gatehouse is a rarer thing from his hand.
